NBT XP Storage is a mod that allows XP bottles to store NBT containing the amount of XP they will yield once broken. This mod is fully server-side, so no client installation is required.

XP bottles now contain an optional `xp` NBT tag, which specifies the amount of XP points that the XP bottle will yield once it is thrown and breaks. If enabled, players can shift + right-click while holding an empty bottle to convert it into an XP bottle with a configurable amount of XP stored in it.

## Commands

- `/nbtxp amount` - returns the current XP consumption amount
- `/nbtxp amount set` - sets the current XP consumption amount
- `/nbtxp consumption` - returns whether consumption is enabled or not
- `/nbtxp consumption enable` - enables XP consumption by shift + right-clicking
- `/nbtxp consumption disable` - disables XP consumption by shift + right-clicking
